scope: Requested exploratory summary: borrow area only for ResNet; retain existing GPT-2 and GCN results
area_scope: Complete accelerator endpoints, including data/configuration storage, adapters and DMA; common Rocket/GEMM/upstream AutoLink excluded
area_units: SAED14 library area units, not asserted to be mm^2
borrowed_resnet_area: Use current CGRA complete endpoint as a proxy, shared with the other rows; use the archived two independent 64 KiB Add/ReLU endpoints as the ASIC proxy. No same-version ResNet AE measurement is claimed.
performance_scope: Configuration-resident end-to-end RTL cycles, including execution transfers and visibility; three repeats per backend
formula: Speedup = mean ASIC cycles / mean CGRA cycles. Relative cycle-area efficiency = Speedup * ASIC endpoint area / CGRA endpoint area.

rows.evidence: Conditional area estimate: borrowed current CGRA endpoint area and historical split ASIC area; not matched performance-area provenance
Matched RTL cycles and mapped endpoint area; common physical target timing not met
Matched RTL cycles and mapped endpoint area; common physical target timing not met

arithmetic_average.scope: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of these three explicitly different baseline cases; includes ResNet borrowed area; not cross-workload reuse on a fixed ASIC inventory

resnet_pair.scope: Add-to-ReLU region including execution and internal transfer, not end-to-end or pure arithmetic
